verdict.rationale: Jules documents that it needs access to your repositories and integrates directly with GitHub, for example by assigning tasks with a "jules" issue label. Community users praise its GitHub integration, and one says a non-developer customer was taught to use it, which hints at low setup friction. However, nothing documents the actual install or authorization flow, so the "one-click" and "without complex setup" parts are only implied. Missing for 10: documented one-click GitHub app install/authorization flow, evidence of minimal setup steps, hands-on corroboration of setup simplicity.
